known_public_facts: AimDK v1.0 contains an X2 MuJoCo simulator and an ONNX deployment example
the bundled example is documented as simulation-validated and requires parameter adaptation for real hardware
the public material does not prove simultaneous native motion-control ownership of lower/waist and external HAL ownership of upper joints
previous v0.8.2 observations found GetAllJointState usable while several joint state topics and odometry topic returned empty payloads
no verified public real foot-wrench, COP, COM or centroidal-momentum interface is currently available to this project

vendor_questions.question: In X2 v1.0 developer/RL_DEFAULT mode, can native MC keep exclusive control of legs and waist while an external process controls only arms (and optionally head)? If yes, provide the supported joint-group ownership API and arbitration rules.
vendor_questions.decision_unblocked: deployment route A native lower + upper overlay versus route B project-owned full-body publisher

vendor_questions.question: When MC, HAL joint command, RL_DEFAULT and remote-controller commands coexist, what is the exact priority, timeout/watchdog behavior and safe fallback state?
vendor_questions.decision_unblocked: safe handoff and recovery state machine

vendor_questions.question: Which X2 controller/firmware versions are compatible with AimDK/SDK v1.0, and is upgrading from the current v0.8.2 stack reversible and supported on this exact 31DoF T2.5 machine?
vendor_questions.decision_unblocked: whether a later supervised SDK upgrade is valid

vendor_questions.question: For real X2 RL deployment, confirm the authoritative 31-joint order, units, command type, Kp/Kd ownership, valid rate and command limits.

What is the supported real-time source for q/dq/effort, base orientation/angular velocity and base linear velocity in v1.0? Are per-group state topics expected to contain joints, or must applications use GetAllJointState?
Are command and state timestamps hardware-synchronized, what clock domain is used, and what end-to-end latency/jitter is guaranteed or measurable?

Does X2 v1.0 provide a supported native locomotion or whole-body controller accepting vx/vy/wz plus upper-body targets? If so, provide command space, supported modes and whether waist belongs to locomotion or upper-body ownership.
vendor_questions.decision_unblocked: whether BASE_LOCOMOTION should be replaced or retained

vendor_questions.question: Are left/right foot contact, estimated normal force, six-axis wrench or COP available on this hardware? Specify topic/service, units, update rate and whether values are measured or model-estimated.
vendor_questions.decision_unblocked: real contact gate and recovery detection

vendor_questions.question: What is the vendor-supported sequence for entering/exiting RL_DEFAULT, zero torque, damping, stand and emergency stop, and which transitions may be commanded while the robot is loaded?
Are there authoritative palm/wrist and sole/contact tracking frames beyond wrist-roll and ankle-roll links, including calibrated transforms?
What exact robot/configuration and observation/action schema does the bundled ONNX target, and is a compatible X2 T2.5 checkpoint available for validation only?

user_confirmation_before_future_robot_wo: explicit permission for any real robot command
working emergency stop and tether/gantry decision
